#include <iostream>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

int main(void){
   string str,ans;
   int taken=0,i;
   cin>>str;

   for(i=0;i<str.size();i++){
      if(str[i]!='a'&&str[i]!='d'){
         ans.push_back(str[i]);
         continue;
      }

      if(str[i]=='a'){
         if(i==str.size()-1||(str[i+1]!='t')||ans.size()==0||taken){
            ans.push_back(str[i]);
            continue;
         }

         taken=1;
         ans.push_back('@');
         i++;
         continue;
      }

      if(str[i]=='d'){
         if(i>=str.size()-3||!(str[i+1]=='o'&&str[i+2]=='t')||ans.size()==0){
            ans.push_back(str[i]);
            continue;
         }

         ans.push_back('.');
         i+=2;
         continue;
      }
   }

   cout<<ans;

   return 0;
}

</perturbed_code_1>
